info.name: Shyft Customer Authentication > Email Customer > EWA API
[ewa_account] get or create my EWA account

items.docs:
Description
- - - 
- This is the first API call when user choose to use EWA by clicking the function button.
- It will find the current user's existing EWA account and return its profile. 
- It will create a new basic EWA account for current user if not found one, and return its profile 

If got `tos_yes=false`, front-end want to present these TOS pages again. 
If got no `active_bank_account`, front-end want to present the bacnk account linking page
